items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Did pit orchestra work for John Robicheaux then moved to St. Louis... Well that's what happened, because I left the boats and I went back in the Lyric Theater.

ctx.x: No, I got hired out of the Lyric Theater to go on the ......... But before then I'd been with Louis at the Orchard. And from the Orchard I went to the Cadillac and that's when I went into the Lyric Theater.

Yes, well he's got this all wrong. You see, he's got with Fate Marable from '21 until '23. Then left the river boats to return to New Orleans. Did pit orchestra work for John Robicheaux then moved to St. Louis." But actually....
Well that's what happened, because I left the boats and I went back in the Lyric Theater.
